verdict:
KILL entry-now with a PRICE gate - the one name in this batch where a price gate is the doctrinally correct instrument, because the finding really is valuation rather than integrity or executability. No escalation trigger fires: benches concordant at 8/10 and 8/10, no ADVANCE, not held, next print ~2026-10-29 (UNCONFIRMED).

THE TRIGGER ITSELF WAS AN ARTIFACT, AND RED'S DECOMPOSITION IS THE BEST SINGLE PIECE OF WORK IN THIS BATCH. AXTI entered the queue on a velocity dislocation (1d -17% on 2026-08-11) with a pack dd52 of -43% off a $143.16 52-week high. Red pulled the session bars and $143.16 APPEARS IN NO SESSION BAR - the window maximum high is $90.39 on 08-10, with closes running 88.58 -> 73.81. The 'drawdown' that queued this name is a summary-statistic or extended-hours artifact. Decomposed properly the stock sits roughly 10-15% off its regular-session all-time high, +121% above its 2026-07-29 close, and 25-40x off its 52-week low. And the -17% day itself is a cohort event, not a company event: primary trade press describes the 08-10 optical selloff (COHR -12%, LITE -7%) as profit-taking and pre-earnings de-risking with no fresh negative headline, landing eleven days after AXTI's own print. Nothing is dislocated because no damage was ever priced in.

TAPE CORRECTION MADE AT ADJUDICATION - AND IT REVERSES BLUE'S ACCUSATION. Blue opened by asserting red 'misstated the pack tape': pack px $77.45 (08-15 ibkr_gw build), not Yahoo's 08-14 close of $81.64, calling it a 5% source divergence neither bench could resolve. Verified IBKR daily closes: 08-13 $77.45, 08-14 $81.64. So $77.45 is simply the 08-13 CLOSE - blue's newer pack build was serving a one-day-STALE price, and red's $81.64 was the correct freshest close. This is not a source divergence at all; it is pack staleness, and the SAME defect appears on KEEL in this batch with the benches' roles identical (later bench, older price, accusing the earlier bench of staleness). Red's session-bar work is separately confirmed: the 08-10 high of $90.39 matches exactly.

WHERE BLUE CORRECTED RED, BOTH CORRECTIONS STAND AND NEITHER RESCUES THE NAME. First, the multiple: red computed EV on 06-30 cash while charging the company for a secondary that closed after the balance-sheet date. Pro-forma the ~$600.1M net proceeds, cash is roughly $1.35B and EV about $3.7B, so ~14x annualised Q3 guided sales, not 17.6x. Still about 65x annualised GAAP guide EPS ($0.29-0.31 per quarter). Direction unchanged. Second, and more interesting doctrinally: red killed the thesis's load-bearing number - '$66M of Q3 revenue already permitted or permit-exempt' - as existing in no vetted venue, with zero EDGAR full-text hits for 'permit-exempt' across the issuer's entire corpus against 155 hits for 'permit'. Blue confirmed the absence from the 10-Q and the PR but found the statement verbatim from the CFO on the scripted earnings call, and then made the ruling that matters: the PR contains NO guidance at all, so ALL forward disclosure at this issuer is call-only company practice. Under the honesty doctrine that is a sourcing-grade venue difference, not takeaway-divergence masking - a RECLASSIFY, not an ELEVATE. Red's kill is overstated as written. A scripted CFO call statement is a 10b-5-liable public representation.

WHAT SURVIVES AND KILLS ANYWAY. The Lumentum agreement is NOT a revenue floor: the vetted exhibit says deposits are applied as shipment credits until exhausted, and there is no take-or-pay minimum or shortfall/refund remedy anywhere - the triage's 'shortfall and refund provisions' appear in neither the 8-K exhibit nor the 10-Q, i.e. they were invented. Blue found the one nuance worth keeping (the exhibit's drafting implies some Lumentum annual commitment through 2031) but no remedy is disclosed. H1-26 had no customer above 10% and the top five were 31%. The Tongmei non-controlling interest including redeemable NCI is 14.5%, so the thesis's attribution of 100% of the China operating company to AXT holders leaks a seventh of it. 100% of substrate manufacturing sits in China, every non-China order is per-order MOFCOM permit-gated, and North America was 0.5% of H1 revenue - which the bull reads as insulation from retaliation and which is more honestly the bear's growth GATE, since the $130M/quarter InP ambition rides the US-destination channel that is exactly the still-pending permit class. Positioning is CROWDED: a $632.5M follow-on into the squeeze, a Form 144 filed 08-07 (the top-tick day), fresh 13Gs, 19-30M share days, and leveraged single-stock ETFs launched 08-13.

The decisive sizing fact is the one management supplied: they sold 9.84M shares at ~$64.25 weeks ago, about 21% below the tape. That is the insiders' own revealed mark, and it is the honest gate.

court.record: batch4 8/15; red 8/blue 8 PARTIALLY OVERTURNED, REJECT-entry AFFIRMED - outcome CONCORDANT. Blue corrected red's multiple (pro-forma the secondary proceeds) and REDUCED red's venue-divergence kill from 'exists nowhere' to 'sourcing-grade', while affirming FLAT.

reopen_gates: PRICE (valuation gate - the doctrinally correct instrument here): at or below $64.25, the secondary print. This is not a derived fair value; it is management's own revealed mark, set weeks ago on 9.84M shares. Below it, finding 3 converts from a kill into an entry.

DATA: the $66M permitted-revenue figure and the permit-cadence language appearing in a LIABILITY-GRADE venue - the 10-Q MD&A full text or the July 424B5 prospectus supplement. Blue is right that call-only guidance is this issuer's practice, but a number this load-bearing should be underwritten from a filed venue before it sizes anything.

EVENT (dated and gradeable): the Q3 10-Q showing the ~2026-09-08 Lumentum $43.5M deposit received as a customer-deposit liability, TOGETHER WITH a filed 8-K granting a US-destination InP permit. Both legs - the cash proves the counterparty, the permit proves the channel.

DATA (resolve the units ambiguity before any model): the widely quoted '$60M by end-2026 / $130M by end-2027' is reported both as capacity and as quarterly revenue. It cannot be company revenue - Q3-26 total revenue guides to ~$66M, already above it. It is almost certainly the InP line, which means anyone modelling $130M/quarter as company total is UNDERSTATING 2027. Nail it from primary before the number is used in either direction.
